name: Use of multiple accounts or prepaid products to stay below thresholds
description: Funds spread across several accounts, prepaid cards or wallets at the same or different providers, each carrying small balances before consolidated cash-out.
fp: Students, migrants and unbanked users frequently use multiple small products.
